title: What The Trumpet Knows — EN/ES/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy Spanish German language learning brass
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The trumpet is the loudest thing in the orchestra by a distance
And everyone in the orchestra maintains a safe clearance
The trumpet player knows this and sits at the back right corner
Which is where the loudest person always is — a fair warning

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La trompeta es lo más ruidoso de la orquesta con diferencia
[The trumpet is the loudest thing in the orchestra by a distance]
Y todos mantienen de ella una prudente distancia
[And everyone maintains a prudent distance from it]
El trompetista sabe esto y se sienta atrás a la derecha
[The trumpet player knows this and sits at the back right]
Donde siempre se sienta la persona más fuerte — esa es la fecha
[Where the loudest person always sits — that's the given]

[Chorus — English]
What does the trumpet know that I don't know?
It knows that projection is the thing that runs the show
What does the trumpet know at nine in the morning?
It knows the whole house is awake without any warning
That's my boy

[Bridge — German, with English translation]
Die Trompete ist das lauteste Instrument im Orchester
[The trumpet is the loudest instrument in the orchestra]
Jeder im Orchester hält Sicherheitsabstand — ein Gesetz
[Everyone in the orchestra keeps a safe distance — a law]
Der Trompeter weiß das und sitzt hinten rechts in der Ecke
[The trumpet player knows this and sits in the back right corner]
Wo der Lauteste immer sitzt — das ist die klügste Strecke
[Where the loudest always sits — that is the wisest stretch]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the trumpet knows… Lo que sabe la trompeta… Was die Trompete weiß
Projection is the argument — La proyección es el argumento — Projektion ist das Argument
That's my boy
